says: On the Worker, a Process object's monitor goes through the Project's one ProcessManager, whose recipient is the brain's own client, so a program's DOWN would land in client:brain/inbox and never in its own inbox.

cost: No program monitors yet, so nothing breaks today; the first program that monitors another on Workers would never get its DOWN.
